en.note: Practice cases appear in the exercises section; quiz questions are answered in sequence

units.outcome: Classify an error and explain why a financial claim remains unverified
Identify a generalization not supported by the original source data
Specify the checks needed to authenticate a citation before relying on it
Distinguish financial metrics and document discrepancies
Separate an AML risk indicator from an established fact and propose human escalation
Document a hold or release decision supported by verifiable evidence
